headline_seed: Odesa bears brunt of latest Russian attacks on Ukraine – Europe live
description_seed: Across country, more than 10 people have been injured as Ukrainian prime minister Julia Svyrydenko prepares to visit Poland Another night of Russian drone attacks on Ukraine overnight left more than 10 people injured, particularly damaging residential buildings in the Odesa region. The strikes caused the biggest damage in the central Prymorskyi district, where residential buildings, a hotel and facilities in the center of the city were damaged, Serhiy Lysak, the head of the local military administration, said on Telegram in comments reported by Reuters.
